HOU.summary:
- **Texans offensive line** — Houston’s biggest roster concern is still the offensive line; the piece notes the unit was better than 2024 but still not above average, with pass protection holding up at a near-top-10 pressure rate allowed of 35.2%. That matters for C.J. Stroud’s fantasy ceiling and the consistency of the passing game if the front doesn’t take another step [2]

- **Jaylin Smith (CB)** — The second-year corner is reportedly back to 100% entering OTAs after his 2025 rookie season ended with a torn meniscus, and he’s already showing well enough to be mentioned as a bounce-back candidate down the depth chart. It doesn’t move fantasy much, but it does matter for Houston’s defensive depth and matchup strength if the secondary keeps its current form [3]
